relations.subject: Kshetresa Chandra Chattopadhyaya
relations.evidence: passed the matriculation examination of the Calcutta University in 1913 from Hindu School of Calcutta

relations.subject: Kshetresa Chandra Chattopadhyaya
relations.evidence: He then attended the Presidency College, Calcutta for Intermediate examination and passed in 1915.

relations.subject: Kshetresa Chandra Chattopadhyaya
relations.evidence: passed the B.A. examination of Allahabad University (1917)

relations.subject: Kshetresa Chandra Chattopadhyaya
relations.evidence: M.A. in Sanskrit from Queen's College, Benares (1919)

relations.subject: Kshetresa Chandra Chattopadhyaya
relations.evidence: He also passed the M.A. Examination in Veda from Calcutta University in 1921

relations.subject: Kshetresa Chandra Chattopadhyaya
relations.evidence: Chattopadhyaya was a student of Dr. Ganganath Jha.

relations.subject: Kshetresa Chandra Chattopadhyaya
relations.role: lecturer in the department of Sanskrit
relations.evidence: Chattopadhyaya joined University of Allahabad as a lecturer in the department of Sanskrit in 1924. In the year 1950 he was promoted to reader

relations.subject: Kshetresa Chandra Chattopadhyaya
relations.evidence: In the year 1950 he was promoted to reader and from 1956 for about a couple of years he acted as professor of Sanskrit.

relations.subject: Kshetresa Chandra Chattopadhyaya
relations.evidence: from 1956 for about a couple of years he acted as professor of Sanskrit.

relations.subject: Kshetresa Chandra Chattopadhyaya
relations.evidence: Later he became Director, Research Institute at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University, Benares.

relations.subject: Kshetresa Chandra Chattopadhyaya
relations.role: special scholar for comparative study of Veda and Avesta
relations.evidence: He was also appointed as a special scholar for comparative study of Veda and Avesta by the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India at Kendriya Sanskrit Vidyapeeth, Tirupati.

relations.subject: Kshetresa Chandra Chattopadhyaya
relations.role: Stephan's Nirmalendu Ghosh Lecturer on Comparative Religion
relations.evidence: The Calcutta University appointed him Stephan's Nirmalendu Ghosh Lecturer on Comparative Religion in 1960
